Deshabilite el servicio asociado y elimine el driver solo después de capturar la evidencia y con aprobación de IR.
Dado el compromiso a nivel de kernel, reinstale el sistema desde una imagen confiable y rote credenciales usadas en el host.

en.summary: The file C:\Windows\System32\drivers\MoriyaStreamWatchmen.sys was created, a driver name tied to the Moriya rootkit described in Securelist's Operation TunnelSnake report. Treat the endpoint as possibly compromised at kernel level.
en.what_it_detects: A file_event whose TargetFilename is exactly C:\Windows\System32\drivers\MoriyaStreamWatchmen.sys, a name reported as the Moriya rootkit's kernel-mode driver.
en.why_it_matters: Installing a malicious driver as a Windows service (T1543.003) gives persistence and kernel privileges. Such a rootkit can hide traffic and commands and evade endpoint controls.
triage_steps: Confirm the exact TargetFilename and review the Image and User of the process that wrote it.
Collect the .sys hash and check its digital signature and reputation; analyze only in an isolated sandbox.
Review the process tree: ParentImage, command line and child processes of the creator within +/- 15 minutes.
Look for service creation (Event ID 7045, 4697) or HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services changes referencing the driver.
Check whether the driver loaded (Sysmon Event ID 6) and whether the host rebooted recently.
Review unusual inbound and outbound network connections from the host and pivot on destination IPs.
Hunt for the same filename or hash on other endpoints and check earlier alerts for the host and user.
false_positives: Unknown per the rule; a legitimate match is very unlikely.
Authorized red team or adversary emulation recreating the artifact; confirm with the owning team.
response_steps: Escalate immediately as a critical incident and isolate the host after confirming the artifact.
Preserve evidence: memory and disk images, a copy of the .sys and logs, before changing the system.
Disable the related service and remove the driver only after evidence capture and IR approval.
Given kernel-level compromise, rebuild from a trusted image and rotate credentials used on the host.
Hunt for related IOCs across the environment and block the hash in EDR.
en.severity_rationale: Critical fits because the filename is specific to a known kernel rootkit and has no documented legitimate use.
